messages:
maria: Heads up — I'm seeing numerical drift / NaNs in ROPE rotations after the kernel-selector switch on the canary cluster. small sample below from a failing trace (seq_len=2048, gpt-medium):

```
max_rot_val=5.12e18
min_rot_val=-inf
nan_count=12
tracepoint: rotate_mul accum overflow at layer 8
commit: abc1234f (kernel-selector: prefer fused_rot_v2)
```

maria: Repro steps attached in the snippet, reproduces reliably on cluster-phi canary.

jonah: Which dtype path? bf16, fp16, or fp32? and which GPU? :eyes:

maria: bf16 by default on canary A100. also reproduced on fp16 on a local V100 with smaller sequence.

liam: Those magnitudes look like accumulation overflow in the fused rotation multiply. Might be missing an eps or wrong intermediate cast when summing.

anya: I can reproduce locally on A100. NaNs show up around token 512 when KV cache is reused across segments. Running with `TORCH_CPP_LOG_LEVEL=info` shows big swings in rotation accumulator.

devops-bot: Canary deployment updated: rotation-kernel=fused_rot_v2 on cluster-phi at 2102345690.

patrick: Quick mitigation idea: clamp inputs to the sin/cos exponent or add `max(abs(x), 1e-6)` guards before any exp/sin calls. Also try keeping accumulation in fp32 and downcast at the end. Example patch: 

```
// pseudo
float acc = 0.0f;
for (...) {
  float term = clamp(x, -1e4f, 1e4f);
  acc += (float)term; // keep in fp32
}
out = (T)acc;
```

jonah: We should add a unit test that runs long-context stress with the fused kernels across dtypes and asserts all outputs are finite. I'll open a PR.

maria: Agreed. Immediate plan: revert kernel-selector to pick fused_rot_v1 for longctx models until we have a patch. @sre-oncall can you schedule a rollback on the canary? :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Scheduling rollback now. ETA ~9m. Will run canary health checks and post results here.

anya: Note: when I force per-layer casting to fp32 the NaNs disappear but perf drops ~8%. We'll need to balance correctness vs perf.

liam: For longer term: instrument per-layer rotation norms in debug builds (histogram/max) so we can catch accumulation drift before it NaNs out. metric name suggestion: `posenc.layer.rotate_accum_max`.

patrick: Proposed rollout checklist: 1) revert canary selector -> v1, 2) add finite-check unit tests + debug metric, 3) implement accumulation guards in fused_rot_v2 (eps/clamp + optional fp32 accumulation), 4) run perf/regression canary (latency + unit tests), 5) gradual rollout with monitoring alert.

maria: I'll open the incident ticket and assign subtasks. quick task list in ticket: reproduce log with minimal snippet, add unit test, benchmark perf delta, implement guard patch, canary run, rollout.

deploy-bot: Rollback executed on cluster-phi at 2102346900. Canary health: OK, no NaNs observed in the last 1000 requests. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks everyone. Follow-up: let's schedule a short RFC to extend kernel-selector policy to include dtype-aware stability heuristics (prefers fp32-accumulate for longctx or when per-layer norm > threshold).

jonah: Also double-check ALiBi variant — it may not overflow the same way but could exhibit phase wrap drift at long seqs. Add ALiBi variant to the test matrix.

anya: I'll run the expanded stress suite (ROPE + ALiBi) and drop results in the ticket.

liam: Also add a perf micro-benchmark so we can quantify the perf hit of fp32 accumulation across GPUs.

patrick: Once tests are green, I'll cut a canary patch that toggles an env var `ROT_ACCUM_GUARD=1` for faster verification.

maria: One more: add a short changelog note and add an eval prompt that checks for semantic/regression fuzzing across the canary.

jonah: PR opened for unit tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 (WIP).

maria: Great — keep updates here. Thanks all. :shipit:
